title: Golf plus 2007
notes: Confirmed sold fast. Cheap Golf/Golf Plus around 1000-1200 EUR can move quickly even with normal old-car mileage when price is pain-low. Treat as urgent manual check if TUV/body/engine/gearbox are not hard-red-flagged.

title: VW Golf V 2006 TUV bis 2027
notes: Confirmed sold fast. Golf 5 with valid TUV under roughly 1600 EUR is real demand. Mileage is acceptable for this price if body/rust/clutch/cooling are plausible.

title: Volkswagen Golf 1.9 TDI United
notes: Confirmed strong/sold-type lead. Golf 5 1.9 TDI at very low price is high urgency. Diesel mileage can be judged more softly than petrol if DPF/EGR/turbo/clutch/service story is clean.

title: Opel Astra Kombi
notes: Confirmed sold fast. Cheap Astra H/Kombi around 1000-1500 EUR has real budget-family demand. Do not bury only because it is older; inspect rust, clutch, gearbox, engine leaks and TUV.

title: Opel Astra H
notes: Confirmed sold fast. Astra H petrol/diesel around 1100 EUR is a serious lead when description has no engine/gearbox/dealer/export red flags. Low price creates fast buyer demand.

title: Volkswagen Polo 1.2 44kW
notes: Polo still sells because the buyer pool is huge, but 220k+ petrol is high mileage. Keep as CHECK unless price is around 1000-1300 EUR, TUV/engine/gearbox are plausible, and there are no warning lights/rust/export/Bastler signals.

title: VW Polo 1.2 Benzin 5 Tuerer TUV Klima
notes: Polo with 5 doors, TUV/Klima and around 1200 EUR fits fast budget demand. Small comfort defects can be negotiation, but engine/gearbox/rust/TUV remain must-check.
